'''Polly''' was a [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|mantellian flutterplume]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was killed during the [[Dantooine Incursion]] of the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Marauders" />
